name: Webflow MCP Server
summary: Webflow's remote MCP server (OAuth) for building and managing Webflow sites: elements, styles, components, CMS, pages, assets, SEO and analytics.
description: Add `https://mcp.webflow.com/mcp` (HTTP transport) to Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT or Codex; OAuth grants access to one workspace per authorization and installs the companion MCP Bridge App, which is needed only for Designer-canvas actions (snapshots, image uploads, current selection/page). Agents work within the user's existing Webflow roles and changes appear in the site activity log; per-site Agent Instructions can guide agents. Analytics, Optimize and AEO tools need the matching paid add-ons. Cannot create new site projects. The open-source local server (`webflow-mcp-server` on npm, 1.0.0, MIT) wraps the Webflow Data API; the docs also expose a separate docs MCP at `https://developers.webflow.com/_mcp/server`.
